description.text: The Daml SDK the packages are built with (sdk-version in daml.yaml); install it with dpm install <version>.

name.text: Download the C# generator on the first build

description.text: Let the first build on a machine download the pinned C# code generator (DamlAllowToolInstall in the app's project). Without it, a machine that hasn't got the generator yet needs one build with DamlAllowToolInstall=true first.
